operations.command:
set -e
. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh
install -m 600 /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash /var/tmp/e2e-before-password-limit
oversize=$(perl -e 'print "A7!z" x 128')
if NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD="$oversize" nixosctl change-password > /tmp/e2e-password-limit.log 2>&1; then exit 1; fi
grep -F 'Passwords must not exceed 511 bytes' /tmp/e2e-password-limit.log
accepts testpass123
cmp /var/tmp/e2e-before-password-limit /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash
printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root)"
printf oversized-password-preserved-both

set -e
. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh
root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root)
legacy=$(perl -e 'print "A7!z" x 128, "x"')
printf '%s\n%s\n' testpass123 "$legacy" | cryptsetup luksChangeKey "$root"
printf %s "$legacy" | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root"
NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD="$legacy" NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=testpass123 nixosctl change-password --full-disk-encryption-only > /tmp/e2e-long-old-password.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/e2e-long-old-password.log; exit 1; }
printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root"
if printf %s "$legacy" | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root"; then exit 1; fi
accepts testpass123
cmp /var/tmp/e2e-before-password-limit /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash
printf longer-existing-luks-password-rotated

set -e; . /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh; root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root); if NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=unapplied456 nixosctl change-password --update-tpm2 > /tmp/e2e-tpm-preflight.log 2>&1; then cat /tmp/e2e-tpm-preflight.log; exit 1; fi; grep -F "Managed TPM enrollment is unavailable; no passwords changed" /tmp/e2e-tpm-preflight.log; printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root"; if printf %s unapplied456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root"; then exit 1; fi; accepts testpass123; if accepts unapplied456; then exit 1; fi; printf tpm-preflight-preserved-both

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password --full-disk-encryption-only > /tmp/e2e-luks.log 2>&1 && printf %s newpass456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && ! printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && accepts testpass123 && printf luks-changed || { cat /tmp/e2e-luks.log; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && printf %s newpass456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$root" && accepts testpass123 && printf luks-survived-reboot || { cryptsetup luksDump "$root"; exit 1; }

set -e
. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh
install -m 600 /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash /var/tmp/e2e-authority-before-failure
mkdir -p /var/tmp/e2e-password-failure
printf '#!/bin/sh
cat >/dev/null
exit 73
' > /var/tmp/e2e-password-failure/mkpasswd
chmod 755 /var/tmp/e2e-password-failure/mkpasswd
# Use the same installed CLI binary, without its PATH wrapper, to inject a
# hash-generation failure after the real passwd/PAM operation has succeeded.
ctl=$(readlink -f "$(command -v nixosctl)")
ctl="${ctl%/*}/.nixosctl-wrapped"
test -x "$ctl"
if PATH="/var/tmp/e2e-password-failure:$PATH" NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 "$ctl" change-password > /tmp/e2e-partial-change.log 2>&1; then
  echo 'expected injected hash-generation failure'; exit 1
fi
grep -F 'The account uses the new password, but its persistent update failed.' /tmp/e2e-partial-change.log
grep -F 'mkpasswd failed' /tmp/e2e-partial-change.log
if grep -F -e testpass123 -e newpass456 /tmp/e2e-partial-change.log; then exit 1; fi
accepts newpass456
cmp /var/tmp/e2e-authority-before-failure /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash
printf %s newpass456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root)"
printf partial-change-known-states

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && accepts testpass123 && ! accepts newpass456 && cmp /var/tmp/e2e-authority-before-failure /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash && printf %s newpass456 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root)" && printf partial-change-reboot-recoverable

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_OLD_PASSWORD=testpass123 NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password > /tmp/e2e-both.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'LUKS already unlocks' /tmp/e2e-both.log && accepts newpass456 && test "$(printf %s newpass456 | crypt)" = "$(cat /var/lib/nixos/credentials/password-hash)" && printf converged-both || { cat /tmp/e2e-both.log; exit 1; }

. /var/tmp/e2e-crypt.sh && root=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-root) && NIXOS_NEW_PASSWORD=newpass456 nixosctl change-password > /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log 2>&1 && grep -F 'LUKS already unlocks' /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log && grep -F 'already uses the new password' /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log && printf idempotent || { cat /tmp/e2e-idempotent.log; exit 1; }
